name: How long federal civil cases take: outcomes, class actions and pro se share by district, nature of suit and year
description: Federal civil cases from the Federal Judicial Center's Integrated Database (IDB), counted by district, nature-of-suit group and fiscal year: cases filed, the share alleging a class action, the share with a pro se plaintiff, cases terminated, the median days from filing to disposition, the trial share, the median days to trial, and how terminated cases ended (settled, voluntarily dismissed, dismissed, default or consent, motion, trial, other, moved out). One record per district and group for the latest three fiscal years, each with its yearly series, plus a national record per nature-of-suit code. Only aggregates are published: no case-level row, party, docket number or judge. Filings re-add to the U.S. Courts' own totals within half a percent.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). How long federal civil cases take: outcomes, class actions and pro se share by district, nature of suit and year (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898111

distribution.name: idb-civil.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: idb-civil.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: idb-civil-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in idb-civil-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to idb-civil.csv on id.

distribution.name: district-group-year-values.csv
distribution.description: The other columns of district-group-year.csv, one row per key, column and value (index.json names the key columns).

distribution.name: district-group-year.csv
distribution.description: An aggregate table of the dataset (index.json lists its columns); its other columns are in district-group-year-values.csv.

distribution.name: nos-year-values.csv
distribution.description: The other columns of nos-year.csv, one row per key, column and value (index.json names the key columns).

distribution.name: nos-year.csv
distribution.description: An aggregate table of the dataset (index.json lists its columns); its other columns are in nos-year-values.csv.

recordSet.name: idb-civil
recordSet.description: The records of How long federal civil cases take: outcomes, class actions and pro se share by district, nature of suit and year, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: district
field.description: The federal district court key (NYS, CAC, ...), or US for all district courts together

field.name: group
field.description: Our nature-of-suit group (personal-injury, employment, ...) or all

field.name: kind
field.description: district-group (a district and a group) or nos (the whole US for one nature-of-suit code)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Median days from filing to disposition, over cases the district itself resolved in the window; from 10 or more cases

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: window
field.description: The fiscal years pooled in the record (three years, October to September)

field.name: filed
field.description: Cases filed in the window

field.name: terminated
field.description: Cases terminated in the window

field.name: resolved
field.description: Terminated cases minus transfers out, remands, MDL transfers and statistical closings

field.name: classActions
field.description: Filed cases flagged as alleging a class action (Rule 23)

field.name: trials
field.description: Resolved cases that ended in a jury verdict, directed verdict or court trial

field.name: trialPct
field.description: Trials as a percent of resolved cases; from 10 or more cases

field.name: trialsWithDate
field.description: Trials with a usable start date

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: note
field.description: Caveats

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
